Both parties may terminate the Agreement with immediate effect
- - of either party breaches a material term of the Agreement
- - in case of a merger or change of key management or control
- - in case of bankruptcy or similar.

payments.description: Dragon Systems must compensate MMI for services at the rates in Annex "Prices"; MMI invoices based on actual shipments.
payments.conditionNote: Due within 30 days after delivery, or when agreed after delivery of installments or Dragon Systems' receipt of invoice, whichever is later; delivery and invoice dates are not fixed in the document.

quotes.text:
Dragon Systems will compensate MMI for all Services rendered in accordance with
the rates specified in the Annex "Prices." Unless otherwise agreed, prices shall
exclude transport, insurance, VAT and Import duties (outside EC countries) to
Dragon Systems' designated delivery address.

MMI will invoice Dragon Systems based on actual shipments that have been
performed.

Payments will be due in US dollars within 30 days after delivery, or when agreed
after delivery of installments or the receipt of invoice by Dragon Systems,
which ever is later. MMI shall invoice Dragon Systems indicating the performed
services in US$ with reference to this Agreement.

ambiguities: Clause 5 refers to rates in Annex "Prices," but the attached price sheets are redacted as [**], so no fixed amount can be extracted.

payments.description: Dragon Systems must pay an Inventory Carriage Charge for materials in stock older than 90 days.
payments.conditionNote: Applies only for materials in stock older than 90 days; amount depends on the materials' value and the redacted percentage rate.

quotes.text:
For all materials in stock, older than 90 days, MMI will charge Dragon Systems
with an Inventory Carriage Charge of [**] of its value per month.

Payments will be due in US dollars within 30 days after delivery, or when agreed
after delivery of installments or the receipt of invoice by Dragon Systems,
which ever is later. MMI shall invoice Dragon Systems indicating the performed
services in US$ with reference to this Agreement.

ambiguities: Clause 5 redacts the Inventory Carriage Charge rate as [**], so no fixed amount can be calculated.

payments.description: Dragon Systems is responsible for transport, insurance, VAT and import duties (outside EC countries) excluded from prices, unless otherwise agreed.
payments.conditionNote: Only where such charges apply and unless otherwise agreed; the document does not fix amounts or dates for those charges.

payments.description: MMI must reimburse Dragon Systems and hold Dragon Systems harmless from liabilities or obligations resulting from MMI's or its employees' or agents' activities under the Agreement.
payments.conditionNote: Applies if liabilities or obligations are imposed on Dragon Systems as a result of MMI's or its employees' or agents' activities under the Agreement.

quotes.text:
MMI shall reimburse Dragon Systems and hold Dragon Systems harmless from any
liabilities or obligations imposed upon Dragon Systems resulting directly or
indirectly from MMI's or its employees or agents activities under this
Agreement.

payments.description: MMI must defend and indemnify Dragon Systems against qualifying patent or copyright infringement claims and pay resulting costs and damages.
payments.conditionNote: Applies if a covered infringement claim is made and Dragon Systems promptly informs MMI in writing and gives MMI sole control of the defense and settlement negotiations.

quotes.text:
MMI will defend and indemnity
Dragon Systems against a claim that the Services supplied hereunder infringe a
patent or copyright and will pay resulting costs and damages provided that
Dragon Systems (i) promptly informs MMI in writing of the claim and (ii) gives
MMI sole control of the defense and all related settlement negotiations.

payments.description: MMI must indemnify Dragon Systems for theft, loss or damage to Dragon Systems property under MMI's care, custody or control.
payments.conditionNote: Applies if there is theft, loss or damage to Dragon Systems property under MMI's care, custody or control.

quotes.text:
MMI shall immediately notify Dragon Systems in
writing of any theft, loss or damage to any Dragon Systems property and shall
indemnify Dragon Systems in respect of the same.
